title: Behaviour one step closer: motor-neuron readouts on the male CNS (SIMULATED)
status: registered before any drug condition was run with motor-neuron readouts
seen_before_registration: every result of the FlyWire study, the MaleCNS replication, the confirmations and checks

exploration, vehicle only, seeds 9000-9001: no drive -> no motor neuron fires; sugar -> proboscis motor pool (pm) about 31 Hz, front-leg pool (fl) about 2-3 Hz; sugar+bitter -> pm about 6 Hz; JO-CE -> fl about 5-7 Hz, pm about 5 Hz; under every drive about 200 motor neurons reach 10 Hz, wing motor neurons 40-55 Hz

design.model: the MaleCNS model of the parent (Traced bodies, consensus-transmitter signs, Shiu constants), published protocols, no background
design.conditions: vehicle and the 21 drug conditions of fly_chip_to_animal.json
design.trials: 8 per protocol and condition, seeds 600-607 (the replication's), so its interneuron readouts must reproduce

pools.proboscis: motor neurons (superclass vnc_motor or cb_motor) with subclass pm, both sides
pools.front_leg: motor neurons with subclass fl, both sides

readouts.proboscis_sugar: mean rate of the proboscis pool under sugar drive
readouts.proboscis_sugar_bitter: mean rate of the proboscis pool under sugar and bitter drive
readouts.front_leg_jon_ce: mean rate of the front-leg pool under JO-CE drive
readouts.motor_recruited_sugar: motor neurons at 10 Hz or more under sugar drive

design.motor_disruption: mean over the four readouts of |log2((x + 1) / (x_vehicle + 1))|
design.chip: the replication's array readouts (malecns_conditions_SIMULATED.csv, seeds 500-502), unchanged

MR0_interneuron_readouts_reproduce.statement: Same seeds, same code: the replication's MN9, aBN1 and descending readouts come back

MR1_the_motor_pools_carry_the_behaviours.statement: Vehicle: sugar drives the proboscis pool, bitter gates it, antennal drive reaches the front legs more than sugar does
MR1_the_motor_pools_carry_the_behaviours.test: proboscis_sugar >= 10 Hz, proboscis_sugar_bitter <= 0.5 x proboscis_sugar, front_leg_jon_ce >= 1.5 x the front-leg pool's rate under sugar

MR2_disinhibition_releases_the_gate_at_t.statement: GABA block raises the proboscis pool under sugar and bitter
MR2_disinhibition_releases_the_gate_at_t.test: Spearman(block, proboscis_sugar_bitter) over vehicle + 5 gaba_block levels >= 0.8

MR3_excitation_block_silences_motor_outp.statement: ACh block lowers the proboscis pool under sugar and the front-leg pool under antennal drive

MR4_chip_tracks_motor_disruption.statement: The chip's firing-rate change tracks motor disruption
MR4_chip_tracks_motor_disruption.test: Spearman(|delta log2 mfr|, motor_disruption) >= 0.6 over the 21 drug conditions

MR5_chip_still_late_at_the_motor_level.statement: The chip at its registered threshold flags drugs after motor output is impaired
MR5_chip_still_late_at_the_motor_level.test: first motor-impairment dose < first chip-detection dose in at least 4 of the families with any motor impairment

MR6_motor_output_fails_no_later_than_int.statement: Motor output is impaired at a dose no higher than the interneuron readouts
MR6_motor_output_fails_no_later_than_int.test: first motor-impairment dose <= first interneuron-impairment dose (replication's disruption index) in at least 4 of the families impaired at both levels

reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls; MR2-MR6 are reported as uninterpretable if MR0 or MR1 fails.
